title: knowledge(performance): Get behind a key-is-set check in and-condition wastes a DB call
summary: The performance rule for boolean operators now detects when Record.Get() calls happen behind a key-is-set check in an and-condition, which can be wasteful even though it is not unsafe.
key_points: Extends detection to identify Record.Get() calls guarded by key-is-set checks (like Key <> 0 or Key <> '')
Recommends moving the guard clause before the Get() call to avoid unnecessary database operations
Applies when only a field value or default is returned and the guard intentionally means the key is not set
Updated with code samples in both bad and good AL patterns
Provides best practice guidance for conditional record retrieval
